steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: I found them! Over here! They're here!

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Raise your shields! Form up! Don't let her get away!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: All this, just for little ol' me? Besides, why do you think I'm trying to get away?
This is not the first time the Inquisition has tried to take Pascuala's life. But this is the last time she's running.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: —Bring it on!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You wanna kill me? Go ahead and try!
But she is no warrior. It is all she can do to dodge the attacks of two warrior priests.
Soon, even that is becoming difficult.
Shield-wielding clerics block the way in front of her. Behind her is Teach, too weak to even stand.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: *Cough*... What a shame...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: What I wouldn't give to hear those guys squabbling again...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Guess that's too much to ask...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hold on, hold on...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Have you seen Thorns? He was fighting Anastasio just a moment ago!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: ...It's just Anastasio over there now.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Stop, Elysium! You can't steer and use high-powered Arts at the same time!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Elysium!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I have to find him.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sure, he's lived through way more lab explosions than he had any right to, but he's still flesh and blood. Even saltfins have to avoid those steam jets. If...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We have to find him!

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: At long last, you have ended his suffering and brought salvation to the souls of those he tried to drag into the abyss along with him.
Timidly, hesitantly, Anastasio presses the tip of the sword against his own throat.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: ...No. You are not yet worthy to die. Freeing one poor soul who failed to recognize his desires to the last is not enough to atone for your sins.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Reality lies before you, Anastasio. You have yet to eradicate the blight of desire plaguing this land. You are not worthy to...

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Señor Alguacil! Are you alright?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: ...I am fine.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Regroup, slay the remaining bandits, and capture both ships.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I will take Juana myself.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Señor, you promised to pay the bandits...

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: They sought a reward from me like ravenous tuskbeasts, the saliva dribbling down their chins.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Did you truly think they could live honest lives in Aarón, after being paid for such work?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: False kindness is but the worst cruelty.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: ...As you say, Señor Alguacil.
Anastasio can hear the soul-wrenching cries and wailing.
He knows he should board the ship, kill Juana, and end the struggle.
But he does not move.
He feels an emptiness, but does not know what is missing. It is as if Isidro had taken part of him with him.
He turns around to look at the vent Isidro had fallen into, but only the gushing steam answers him.
White steam bursts into red mist. Anastasio turns around to leave.
In the next instant, a flash of light cuts the steam open.
Isidro emerges from it. The Corazonix that had covered his entire body parts ways to reveal his golden eyes.
Anastasio sees something familiar in them. They are the eyes of one who thirsts to kill another, just like his own.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Many people have told me many things about Iberia and the ocean my entire life.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Some say the sea is Iberia's treasure, some its bane. Others say it is the final destination of the Iberians, their grave...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Some have told me it was people like me who destroyed Iberia. Others that its revival depends on people like me.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Some have advised me to stay away from the ocean and live a normal life. Others tell me I can never truly escape it, for it is my only home.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You've talked a lot about my desires.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I admit it. I want to go out to sea.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I want to see it for myself and conquer it.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Then, I will define what Iberia means to me.
As he says these words, Isidro's sword finds Anastasio's neck.
Anastasio feels both relief and fear at the blood flowing from it.
His deepest sins flow out of him along with his blood. He is pure again.
Yet he frantically tries to stop the bleeding.
He is pure again. Meaning he can live again. As long as he stops the bleeding...
But only the blood will atone him.
Anastasio realizes his own paradox.
He stops his motion and falls from the ship and into the gap between the bones.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I want to go out to sea. I WILL go out to sea.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No one can stop me.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Put down your weapons and let go of the wheel!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: *Cough* Delay them, Leaf! Do whatever you have to! Buy as much time as you can!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Can you hang in there, Elysium?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: *Cough* Yeah... for a little while...

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Attack!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You broke the ship again...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I JUST FIXED IT!!!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: GET OUT!!!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wow, Weedy...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thorns!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You're okay!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Dios mío, I can't believe I can see you again!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: D-Don't ever do that again! Did you break your arms? Hmm? Legs? Strange. Everything seems fine. Is your head screwed on straight? Well, I guess it was never really screwed on straight to begin with...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...How on Terra are Weedy and I supposed to write our post-action reports?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whatever, just take this bottle of seasickness medicine.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: More stuff? How much have you given me on this trip? Besides, isn't it a little late for this?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, this one's different. It's extra-strong. It'll come in handy.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Throw the old one overboard.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: If the little one fidgets, tie her up.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: We need to learn how she stole the compass right from under our noses, and whether she had someone on the inside working with her.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Don't move! I'll bandage your wounds now.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Not one step forward!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: You bastards! Your leader promised a reward! Why are you attacking us?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: It is also the Alguacil who has sentenced you to death.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Vete a la mierda! Everything you people say is finshit!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Your leader is dead! Everyone saw him fall from the ship!

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: We can still carry out his will.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: How?! Surrender, and we all go back to town in one piece! Don't, and we all die here!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: We just want to live normal lives! Would you rather die than trust us?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Fine then, just try us!
The surviving pirates raise their swords with their leader's cry.
Not one warrior priest dares step forward.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Out of the way, jóvenes. I'll have the helm.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I said I would take you all out of this reef.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No, I'll do it.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You're hurt. Besides, I have the compass.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: ...You do?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: My arm is the compass. I'll explain later. Basically, I can predict when and where each and every jet of steam is going to gush out.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: We'll make it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Excelente. Then we sail.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Where are you going, Señora Juana?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I can't very well let Javier and the others die here.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: They've already raised their sails. Looks like they're leaving.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Everybody who can move, to your stations!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Is the Inquisition just going to watch?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Move your asses and help!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Follow La Conquista if you want to live!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We'll all make it out of Skeletal Reef in one piece!
Those on the salt ship breathe a sigh of relief when the last jet of steam can no longer reach them.
Some sit on the deck, some lie down, all exhausted.
Finally able to relax, Juana starts stomping around the deck.
Finding a spot that sounds hollow, she picks up a cutlass and pries open the planks, revealing a crate of rum.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Aha! Naturally, no one else would ever find MY rum.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We're not far from the sea, Javi!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It will be hard for the salt ship to turn back if it goes any further. Get some rest here. Isidro and I will draw a map of the reef's steam vents so you can sail your way back.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I don't wanna force anyone into a life they don't want... If anyone wants to go with you, I won't stop them.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Whoever wants to go out to sea with Señora Juana—this is your last chance!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: If you do, get aboard La Conquista!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: The rest are coming back to town with me!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Going out to sea? You're still thinking about that? With no supplies, and a skeleton crew?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: What about food and water? Materials for repairs? Medicine? Weapons? This is loco!

steps.name: Doubting Sailor
steps.text: Why even bother at this point? She's out of her mind... sailing to their deaths...

steps.name: Impulsive Sailor
steps.text: Are they really going out to sea? Now?

steps.name: Impulsive Sailor
steps.text: Er, Javier? I...

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Like I said, it's your choice. I won't say anything.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I don't want to live a life I don't want. So I won't force you to either.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Choose. The sun's about to set.
The crowd grows quiet and parts into two groups. A few follow Juana towards the edge of the deck, but turn around quickly.

steps.name: Reluctant Sailor
steps.text: Hey, hermano!

steps.name: Reluctant Sailor
steps.text: Listen, I've got a little package in my drawer. There's a pocketwatch inside, some money, and a letter. Can you take the letter to Abi in town?

steps.name: Reluctant Sailor
steps.text: If you do, the money's all yours. Just make sure she gets the letter, okay? Tell her to wait, because I'll be back with a big pile of coin.

steps.name: Dizzy Sailor
steps.text: You said... Ami?

steps.name: Reluctant Sailor
steps.text: Abi! The redhead!

steps.name: Dizzy Sailor
steps.text: Red Ami... gotcha..

steps.name: Resolute Sailor
steps.text: You're not coming? Don't you wanna see the sea?

steps.name: Weary Sailor
steps.text: I... I'm just too tired... My back's bad these days too. Can't even sleep in a hammock...

steps.name: Weary Sailor
steps.text: The bed we had back in town... it felt so good...

steps.name: Resolute Sailor
steps.text: Guess this is it then.

steps.name: Weary Sailor
steps.text: Adios!
Juana leaps upon La Conquista, followed by the sailors who elected to go with her.
Javier takes another swig of rum.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: ...Adios.
The two ships ride with the wind, sailing across the Salt Flat at a leisurely pace.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Take care of Teach.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: She's not so young anymore, and might need to lie down for a few days, but she should be fine.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You're not going with Señora Juana?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Nah, why the heck would I do that?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I'd rather have a good life, with a lot of money. Going out to sea sounds pretty rough if you ask me.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But you had their back this whole time. I was sure...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Because Juana promised me a lot of money. A LOT of money!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Which will help me meet new people, and find ways to make even more money!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Wait!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Save your breath. I'm just a dirty little thief, after all.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You won't change my mind with a few words.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Okay. Good luck. I hope you find what you want and live a good life.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Thanks, Pelirrojito.
Pascuala pats the salt off herself and jumps on the rope net linking the two ships.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Hasta la vista, baby!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Maybe I'll be rich the next time we meet!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Elysium!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Elysium?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh! What is it?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I was talking to Señora Juana and Thorns. They want to go out to sea, but the ship has taken a beating.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: So I'm going to stay here a while and help with repairs. Getting to work with the frame of a genuine Golden Age battleship, plus a bionic transmission system designed by Señora Juana herself based on saltfin biology... It's fascinating.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Besides, I want to see if my research will be of use on this ship.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: How about you report back to Rhodes Island first? I'll be back once I'm done here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Will you be okay by yourself?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Well, we're short on food, water, and comfortable bedding. Plus the only way to bathe is to wipe yourself off with salt... But nothing a dedicated researcher can't handle.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: A small price to pay for the chance to study such a fascinating subject. Besides, I have Leaf with me.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Alright, I hope you find what you're looking for here.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'll get on with my blueprints, then. See you at Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You too!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: My goodness... Look at what they did to my ship...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't say that! Weedy worked so hard to patch it up! You'll make me cry...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: ...You really don't know when to stop talking, do you?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: A truly handsome man has a way with words!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Are you preparing to set sail, Señora Juana?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What's this now? Concerned for me?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We've had brushes with death together, ate dried saltfin together, even slept under the same blanket. The least I could do is bid you farewell before you go.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Buen camino, señora.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: If we meet again, I'd love to hear all the stories of your adventures on the high seas.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Not a problem.
Walking around the deck, Elysium sees that Teach is finally beginning to regain consciousness.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Are you awake, Señora Teach?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm going back to town with Javier's group. I came to say goodbye.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Haha... thanks...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You know, I've come to admire you a lot, señora... You remind me of my own captain.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: May safe winds take you out to sea, that you may find the battles against wind and wave that you seek.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Thanks, chaval...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, one more thing. Peludita asked me to give you these herbs. Works best when boiled, she said, but can also be chewed and swallowed directly if water is in short supply.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Gracias...
Elysium continues to stride the deck, until he has no more goodbyes left to say.
He walks up to the rope net linking the two ships, and sees a figure standing at the bow of La Conquista.
His old buddy.
He waves at Isidro from a distance.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Adios, amigo.
The salt ship sails off slowly. On the deck, all is quiet, as the crew watches the people they know gradually became smaller.
A few rush up to the edge, as though they had changed their minds and wanted to jump across to the other ship, but are forced to stop as the distance between them grows.
They each watch the other go further and further away.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Look, Javier! The mast of La Conquista!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Ha... hahaha...
Atop the mast, Juana lifts the hems of her dress, as if stepping atop the setting sun.
The fading light adorns her dress with a golden glow.
Wind lifts white grains of salt from the ground like blowing snow.
All eyes are fixated upon her dance, both on this ship and the other.
They look up in silence. The ships sail in opposite directions, with only a few eyes glancing at the sea of white salt before them, and the sunset growing closer or further.
Away they go, until the figures on the other ship have become as small as grains of salt.
